# Williams Systems LLC

> Williams Systems LLC is a full-service software company. One team designs, builds, launches, and supports websites, web apps, SaaS platforms, mobile apps, and the cloud infrastructure behind them.

## Services
- Front-end development: React, Next.js, TypeScript
- Back-end and API development: Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL
- SaaS platform development: multi-tenant products, subscriptions and billing, admin tools, analytics
- Mobile app development: iOS and Android from one codebase (React Native)
- Cloud and DevOps: AWS, Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, backups
- Personalized AI: AI assistants built around a person or business, trained on their own documents, written in their voice, connected to their tools, and private by design

## How projects work
1. Meet: a free call about the goal, the users, and whether we are the right team for it
2. Design: colours, layout, and feel agreed with the client before anything is built
3. Scope: a written scope of work covering what is being built, how long it takes, and the price
4. Build: work starts as soon as the scope is signed, and jobs are delivered fast
5. Launch and support: cloud setup, monitoring, and handover; the client owns the code and accounts, and the same team handles fixes, updates, and new features

## Pricing
Every job is priced either as a one-time cost for the work or as a monthly plan, depending on what the job is. Which one applies is agreed in the written scope before any work begins.

## Product pages
- [Websites](https://lwilliams027.github.io/williams-systems-llc/websites.html): Fast, accessible marketing websites designed and built from scratch around your brand, not a template. They load quickly, show up in search, and turn visitors into customers.
- [Web apps](https://lwilliams027.github.io/williams-systems-llc/web-apps.html): Customer portals, dashboards, and internal tools that replace spreadsheets and manual steps. Secure sign-in, the right permissions for every role, and data you can trust.
- [SaaS platforms](https://lwilliams027.github.io/williams-systems-llc/saas.html): Multi-tenant software products with sign-up, subscriptions and billing, admin tools, and analytics built in, so you can launch, charge, and grow.
- [Mobile apps](https://lwilliams027.github.io/williams-systems-llc/mobile-apps.html): Native-feeling iOS and Android apps from a single codebase that share the back end and design of your web product, published to the App Store and Google Play.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://lwilliams027.github.io/williams-systems-llc/cloud.html): Hosting, deployments, monitoring, and backups set up properly in your own cloud accounts, so releases are routine and outages are rare.
- [Personalized AI](https://lwilliams027.github.io/williams-systems-llc/personalized-ai.html): Personalized AI assistants built around you and your business. They know your documents, your products, and the way you work, and they plug into the tools you already use.

## Solution pages
- [Launch a new product](https://lwilliams027.github.io/williams-systems-llc/launch-a-new-product.html): Take a new software product from idea to launch with one team: design, build, launch, and support, with a written scope and price before any work starts.
- [Modernize an existing app](https://lwilliams027.github.io/williams-systems-llc/modernize-an-app.html): Review, repair, and speed up software you already own: fix what is broken, remove the risk, and make it something a team can safely change again.
- [Replace spreadsheets](https://lwilliams027.github.io/williams-systems-llc/replace-spreadsheets.html): Turn the spreadsheet your business runs on into real software: shaped around your process, safe from accidents, and usable by the whole team at once.
- [Secure your software](https://lwilliams027.github.io/williams-systems-llc/secure-your-software.html): Security work on the software you run: authentication, permissions, secrets, dependencies, and hardening, reviewed and fixed by the team that builds it.
- [Move to the cloud](https://lwilliams027.github.io/williams-systems-llc/move-to-the-cloud.html): Migrate from an old server or host into cloud infrastructure you own, with a planned cutover, tested backups, and a bill that makes sense.
- [Ongoing support](https://lwilliams027.github.io/williams-systems-llc/ongoing-support.html): Ongoing support from the team that built your software: monitoring, updates, fixes, and new features on a monthly plan, with no handover to a stranger.
